items: 【Android 16 | Octa-Core Processor】Our MUISOO 10.1-inch tablet runs the latest Android 16 OS with native support for Google Gemini AI, bringing you a smart assistant for efficient study, work and daily use. It features upgraded privacy protection, smoother system response, and fully customizable settings to keep your data safe. Powered by a high-performance A537 octa-core processor (up to 2.0GHz), it delivers lag-free performance for multi-tasking, online classes, remote work, HD streaming and casual gaming.

【34GB RAM | 128GB + 1TB Expandable】With 34GB max RAM (6GB base + 28GB virtual expansion), this Android tablet handles multiple apps running simultaneously without slowdown, ensuring seamless switching between work, study and entertainment. The 128GB built-in storage offers ample space for your files, photos and videos, and supports up to 1TB TF card expansion, eliminating the hassle of insufficient storage.

【10.1” HD Eye-Protect Screen】Tablets features a 10.1-inch 1280×800 HD display, delivering vivid colors and crisp details. The anti-blue light eye-protection screen effectively reduces eye strain during long-time use, ideal for students and remote workers. With Widevine L1 certification, it supports HD streaming on YouTube, HBO, Disney+ and more for an immersive viewing experience.

【Google GMS Certified | 6000mAh Battery】With official Google GMS certification, tableta comes pre-installed with the genuine Google Play Store and full Google services, ensuring complete app compatibility, stable operation and a secure out-of-the-box experience. The 6000mAh large battery delivers 6-8 hours of continuous use on a single charge, with a universal Type-C port for charging and data transfer.

【Dual Camera | Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 + Bluetooth 5.4】This tablet android comes with a 5MP front camera for clear video calls and face unlock, and an 8MP rear camera with flash for sharp photos, document scanning and HD video recording. Upgraded dual-band 2.4G/5G Wi-Fi 6 + Bluetooth 5.4 delivers faster, more stable connections with lower latency, fully compatible with all your wireless accessories. Dual built-in smart speakers also bring immersive surround sound.

【All-in-One Kit | 12-Month Warranty】The complete package of this computer tablet includes: 10.1-inch tablet, Bluetooth keyboard, wireless mouse, capacitive stylus, wired earphone, protective case, 5V 2A charger and Type-C data cable. It easily transforms into a 2-in-1 laptop-style device for work, study or creation, making it an ideal gift for family and friends. We offer a 12-month warranty and 24/7 online customer service to solve your problems promptly.
